name: Xenomorph
description: A black alien in 51 pieces with an orange cat riding on its back, 11 cm from its claws to the tip of its tail and 8 cm tall to the cat's ears: a long domed head with silver teeth, tubes on its back and a jointed tail with spines and a barb. Every joint moves, and it stands on its two feet and the barb. Designed by yodakya; the cat is our addition.

steps.caption: The hips: a T-bar, stem up. Clip the tile with a clip onto the top end of the stem from the front, its underside facing forward
Press a plate with a level clip onto the underside of the tile, clip up: the waist
Stand the hips' T-bar up, stem leaning a little forward
The thigh: a 1 x 3 plate. On its middle stud a 1 x 1 plate; on one end stud a plate with a ring, ring out to the side: the ankle
On the other end stud a plate with an upright clip, clip out to the other side: the hip
The foot: a 1 x 2 plate, standing on edge. Push one of its end holes onto the rim of the ring that faces the hip, so that it points away from the thigh
The heel: a cheese slope on the ring's other rim, its thin edge towards the toe
Slide the right leg's clip onto the end of the hip bar. The leg stands on its toe and on the slope of its heel
The thigh: a 1 x 3 plate. On its middle stud a 1 x 1 plate; on one end stud a plate with a ring, ring out to the side: the ankle
On the other end stud a plate with an upright clip, clip out to the other side: the hip
The foot: a 1 x 2 plate, standing on edge. Push one of its end holes onto the rim of the ring that faces the hip, so that it points away from the thigh
The heel: a cheese slope on the ring's other rim, its thin edge towards the toe
Slide the left leg onto the other end, to match
The torso: a battle droid's, upside down, its stud to the back. Press the thin middle of its shoulder bar down into the waist clip
An arm: push a claw's bar into the hole in the end of a robot arm, as far as the picture shows, the claw's two prongs one above the other. Make two
Slide an arm onto each end of the shoulder bar, reaching forward
The neck: clip a plate with a level clip onto the bar at the top of the torso, from the front, studs up. Press the silver round plate onto it: the teeth
The head: two 1 x 3 plates in a line, the front one on top of the back one's first stud
A cheese slope on the front stud, sloping down to the front: the snout. A 1 x 1 plate behind it
A 1 x 1 tile on the plate, and the long curved slope behind it, high end forward: the dome
Press the head down onto the teeth, by the hole under its front end
The back: a plate with an upright clip. Press the hinge plate onto its stud, the hinge finger at the far end from the clip
Press the stem of a T-bar into the clip, the end of the stem pointing away from the hinge plate
Clip four droid arms onto the cross bar, two each side of the stem, all trailing to the back: the inner two hanging low, the outer two a little below level
Push the stem of the back's T-bar into the stud on the torso's back, tubes trailing, hinge plate hanging down
The tail's first link: a hinge cylinder with a hole, its two-finger end forward and up. Push a claw's bar down through the hole: a spine
Click the second link onto the first, turned up two clicks, and give it a spine
Click on the third link, turned up two clicks again, and give it a spine
Click on the fourth link, turned down two clicks
The crest: a T-bar, stem down. Clip four claws onto its cross bar, two each side of the stem, bars straight up
Push the crest's stem into the hole in the fourth link, until the claws' jaws just clear the link
The sting: lay the barb on its side and push the short hinge cylinder onto its bar, as far as it goes. The barb curves across the cylinder's two fingers
Click the sting onto the end of the fourth link, turned down two clicks
Click the tail onto the hinge, one click up from the line of the back. The barb comes down onto the table: the third foot
The saddle: press the handle of the 1 x 2 plate into the clip at the end of the outer right tube, from behind, studs up and level. Stand the cat on its two studs, looking forward over the shoulder
